build_retinanet_model_config: build a RetinaNet model config with FPN backbone and ResNet-50 for object detection
create_retinanet_head_config: create a RetinaNetHead config with 9 anchors and focal loss for multi-scale detection
configure_anchor_generator: configure a DefaultAnchorGenerator with 5 scales and 3 aspect ratios for RetinaNet
setup_fpn_backbone: setup an FPN backbone with ResNet-50 and LastLevelP6P7 top block for feature extraction
configure_anchor_matcher: configure a Matcher with 0.4 and 0.5 IoU thresholds for anchor-to-ground-truth matching
